body:
2.10.3 is covered already in V2.4 Credential Storage

2.10.3 | Verify that passwords are stored with sufficient protection to prevent offline recovery attacks, including local system access. |   | ✓ | ✓ | 522
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --

comments.body:
If we look at category names as well, we can interpret it like this:
* V2.10 Service Authentication - passwords stored in the application to access (external) services - it must be possible to get the plain text of the password
* V2.4 Credential Storage - passwords stored in the application for external users and/or services to access the application - no need to read the password plain-text version
We need to make all this clearer during the rework
. o O ( can not see any proposal to review )
